title: More control over files and windows
notes: New: Use a portable Windows version that keeps your settings and plugins beside the app and can update itself in place.
New: Browse Windows network shares and RAR archives like folders, and open destination paths faster with Tab completion.
Improved: Choose permanent apps or commands for specific file types, see more details when files conflict, and rename conflicts in bulk.
Improved: Minimize tasks to the status bar, minimize fman to the system tray, start with a single pane, and keep prompts inside the main window.
Fixed: Alerts, progress dialogs, copied-item selection, and environment-variable paths are now more reliable and easier to use.
